desc:
Tile rummy: the classic number-tile board game, on Roblox! 🀄

Make runs of one color (5-6-7) or groups of one number (7-7-7), rearrange the table, and be the first to empty your rack!

★ Jump straight in: tables of 4 or a quick 1v1
★ No waiting: AI players fill empty seats
★ Play with friends in your own room
★ Free Zone: set your own rules
★ Earn XP and rank up from Bronze to Master
★ Daily rewards, missions and win streaks
★ Unlock new table and tile colors
★ Halloween event until Nov 2 🎃
★ Plays in 18 languages

Rules: no points needed for your first move · can't play? Draw a tile · a joker can be any tile · 12-13-1 counts as a run

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite to get the next update!
